mapper.select: select tenant_id, channel, conversation_key, draft_json::text as draft_json, last_event_id, updated_at from crm_conversation_summary_draft where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and channel = #{channel} and conversation_key = #{conversationKey} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into crm_conversation_summary_draft ( tenant_id, channel, conversation_key, draft_json, last_event_id, updated_at ) values ( #{tenantId}, #{channel}, #{conversationKey}, CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(#{draftJson}), '') AS jsonb), #{lastEventId}, #{updatedAt} ) on conflict (tenant_id, channel, conversation_key) do update set draft_json = excluded.draft_json, last_event_id = excluded.last_event_id, updated_at = excluded.updated_at
mapper.delete: delete from crm_conversation_summary_draft where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and channel = #{channel} and conversation_key = #{conversationKey}
